title: Vem kan segla förutan vind?
attribution: Traditional Swedish-language folk song and lullaby from the Åland islands and Swedish-speaking Finland; the opening line goes back to an 18th-century ballad and the song was first printed in this form in 1909. Melody and words are anonymous and public domain. The D# before the last note of each verse is the raised leading note of the minor key and shows as out-of-key.
